description: DN-v22: v21 + POWER-WEIGHTED GROUP-DELAY PER BAND (where in the 4096-sample window each band's energy lives) -- 48 dim raw + 48 dim smoothed (1-frame causal EMA). Computed via rFFT(n*x)/rFFT(x) trick; intrinsically nonlinear (ratio of band-pooled FFTs). Drops PAC, drops 2 cross-rate features (kept slow*fast=2*48=96). v21=0.0659. subject: patient1
description: DN-v23: v22 + HARMONIC-COMB DEMODULATED COCHLEAGRAM (source-filter split). Per frame, given the detected best F0, decompose band power into VOICED ENERGY (sum at harmonics of best_F0, soft Gaussian comb mask) and APERIODIC ENERGY (the rest). Outputs log_voiced, log_aperiodic, logit-HNR per band = 3*48=144 dim. Intrinsically nonlinear: F0 is detected and used as a divisor for which power is summed. Drops smoothed group delay + 2 STMF kernels to make room. v22=0.0654, v21=0.0659.

Drops dn_wide_med onset/offset (96 dim, redundant with second-order DN on mod env). Net +0 dim. v23=0.0652, v21=0.0659.

description: DN-v29: PER-BAND LICKLIDER AUTOCORRELOGRAM as a NEW nonlinear paradigm. Per band b and pitch-relevant lag tau_k, fb-weighted cos+sin projections of |X|^2 -> analytic autocorrelation magnitude m_bk; normalize by band energy e_b => periodicity ratio r_bk = m_bk/(e_b+sigma). 12 lags spanning F0 60-500 Hz, 48 bands => log1p(r_bk) (576 dim) + best-lag periodicity (48 dim) = 624 new dim of intrinsically nonlinear within-band fine-structure/periodicity (lag-0 cochleagram throws this away). Pruned to fit memory: dropped 6th STMF pair, fut_dn (48), short-window front-end (256), dn_narrow_med (48), dn_sym_med (48), 6Hz mod env row (144). Net: 2975 per-frame * 4 FIR = 11900 dim. v27=0.0674 best.

Cleaner test of whether autocorrelogram lifts v27. Short-window front-end still OFF (256 dim freed) so dim ~3030 per-frame * 4 = 12120. v29=0.0658, v27=0.0674 best.

subject: patient1
description: DN-v31: pivot to FM. Add per-band INSTANTANEOUS MODULATION FREQUENCY: for log_e at rates 4/8/12 Hz, take the complex gabor demod z=c+i*s and compute dphi = arg(z[t+1]*conj(z[t])) -- the phase derivative aka the ACTUAL modulation frequency at that frame, distinct from the magnitude (AM) we already use. Per band per rate, append dphi + env*dphi (signed FM coupled with AM). 3 rates * 2 features (dphi, env*dphi) * 48 bands = 288 dim new. Autocorrelogram trimmed to 6 lags (~F0 100-420 Hz, 288+48=336 dim). Total ~12000 dim. v27=0.0674 best, v30=0.0666.

subject: patient1
description: DN-v32: v31 + CEPSTRUM features. cep = IFFT(log|X|) where log is applied PER FFT BIN before any band pooling. Therefore IFFT(log_p) is NOT a linear function of log_e (= log of band-pooled p) -- ridge over log_e cannot reconstruct it. Low quefrencies 1-40 capture vocal-tract spectral envelope (formants); 24 mid quefrencies (log-spaced 80-600 samples) capture pitch-period source. Total +64 dim. Per-frame 3087, total 12348. v31=0.0670, v27=0.0674 best.

subject: patient1
description: DN-v33: v31 base (no cepstrum) + TEMPORAL VARIANCE & THIRD-MOMENT per band. var_b(t,tau) = ema(log_e^2,tau) - ema(log_e,tau)^2 at tau=15,60 (2*48=96 dim, log1p applied). Third moment m3 = ema((x-mu)^3, tau=30) with sign-preserving log magnitude (48 dim). All intrinsically nonlinear (square / cube). Captures within-band amplitude variability & asymmetry distinct from band-pass AM envelopes. +144 dim. v32=0.0669, v31=0.0670, v27=0.0674 best.
